music.title: Cannon Fodder
music.prompt: Instrumental heavy metal racing anthem. Fast double-kick drums at 168 BPM, chugging palm-muted electric guitars, a soaring lead guitar melody, galloping bass. Relentless forward energy for a goblin marble race on wooden roller coaster tracks. No vocals, no lyrics, consistent energy so it loops well, no long fade-in.

No vocals, no sudden stops, consistent energy so it loops well.
